desc: command line tool to manipulate XMP metadata
r: exempi - command line tool to manipulate XMP metadata

<dl><dt data-o="">-h: show this help</dt><dt>-R: don't reconcile</dt><dt>-x: dump XML</dt><dt>-p: wrap XML packet wrapper. Only for -x.</dt><dt>-X: file(s) is XMP</dt><dt>-w: write in place. Only for -s. Not compatible with -o.</dt><dt>-o <file>: file to write the output to.</dt><dd></dd><dt data-o="">-n <ns> <prefix>: set the prefix for a namespace.</dt><dt>-g <prop_name>: retrieve the value with prop_name.</dt><dt>-s <prop_name> -v <value>: retrieve or get the value.</dt><dd></dd><dt><files> the files to read from.</dt><dd></dd></dl>

The source code hasn't been audited for security. The command line tool doesn't have a strong input sanity checking easier.

Be careful not to run the tool as super-user. Be careful if you decide to use it in an online (web) application.

Patches and suggestions welcome.
